issues.what: 7. Death clip vs the brief (bow, hat tips off and rolls, folds to the ground)
issues.evidence: Clip row 9 and the unit sheet: the hat tips, slides off, rolls and settles with the lantern, and she kneels and folds forward onto her hands. There is still no clear opening bow (frame 2 is a sideways head tilt as the hat goes). The end pose is head-down on hands and knees rather than at rest on the ground.

The Lamplit robe is now a warm walnut: three_tunlan_lamplit.png samples hue 19 degrees, 24-28 % saturation (was hue 247, 3 %). At the game camera (lineup sheet) its hat clearly reads as golden panels with walnut ribs, distinct from the base's white and Noon Fair's lilac. In tunlan_lamplit_splash.png, though, the figure still reads as a beige-brown monochrome, and the hat panels do not look lit from within. Noon Fair is unchanged (plum robe, hue 321 in the splash).

issues.what: 9. Polish: HP bar overlaps the brim; taunt nearly static
issues.evidence: Taunt is fixed: clip row 15, frame 4 has both feet off the ground with a shadow gap, and the ears flop between frames 2-6. issues.what: 11. Lamp slot much larger than the brief's 4 x 1 cm notch
